messages:
alerts-bot: :rotating_light: Anomaly: sudden spike in 5xx and CPU for /v1/prompt-router/adaptive-splitter in prod-eu at 12:15 UTC. Error rate 22% over 10m.
Nina (oncall): I'm awake. Paging SRE + platform. Any recent deploys or flag flips?
DeployBot: Deploy complete: rev ef12c3 to prompt-router services at 12:09 UTC, canary=10%.
Liam (platform): That canary included the adaptive-splitter route (experiment). Rolling back canary to 0% now.
Nina (oncall): Can we flip the flag instead so traffic stops routing to adaptive-splitter entirely? Faster than rollback.
Flagbot: Feature flag `adaptive_splitter_route` currently `on` at 10%.
Liam (platform): Doing immediate emergency toggle via LaunchDarkly API. Command:
```
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $LD_TOKEN" \
  https://flags.internal/api/flags/adaptive_splitter_route \
  -d '{"rollout":0,"comment":"emergency disable - high 5xx/CPU"}'
```
Flagbot: `adaptive_splitter_route` set -> `off` by Liam at 12:20 UTC.
Nina (oncall): Observing: p95 latency dropping, CPU on router pods returning to baseline. 5xx rate trending down.
Ravi (sre): I'm on logs and dumps. Seeing repeated goroutine dumps and `runtime: out of memory` lines on new route worker processes. Example:
```
2026-02-11T12:18:43Z router-adaptive-1 ERR runtime: out of memory
panic: runtime: allocation failed
```
Priya (product): Any indication how many customers were affected? We need to notify if more than X enterprise accounts hit errors.
Ravi (sre): Quick estimate: about 6.1% of total requests routed to adaptive-splitter while canary was on; of those ~35% failed in that window (12:10-12:20). Roughly 2% of overall traffic. A few API keys saw spikes; CS/Support list at internal link: https://support.internal/affected/2102468100
Nina (oncall): PagerDuty: creating incident for on-call escalation.
PagerDuty: Incident PD-9221 created and notified on-call rotations.
Liam (platform): I will hold the flag off. Will also revert the container image roll for that canary until we have a fix.
Ravi (sre): Capturing heap profiles from crash pods and copying to staging artifacts. Command run: `kubectl cp router-adaptive-1:/heap.prof /tmp/heap-210246`
Nina (oncall): Short term mitigation=flag off + scale up legacy workers for any burst. I've raised cluster autoscaler by +2 nodes in prod-eu.
Priya (product): I'm drafting a short status update for status.redwood.com. Message will mention degraded routing for a subset of traffic and immediate mitigation.
DeployBot: Canary roll reverted at 12:25 UTC.
Liam (platform): Confirmed no new occurrences after 12:22 UTC in logs. We'll not re-enable the flag until PR with mem fixes + canary tests pass.
Nina (oncall): Handover: Ravi will own the 4hr follow-up window and coordinate with Platform for repro/patch. I'm documenting timeline and will close the immediate incident once dashboards stable for 30m.
Ravi (sre): Ack. Follow-ups:
- analyze heap profiles, root cause likely unbounded buffer in adaptive path
- add mem limit enforcement and OOM kill guard in router config
- add rollout safety: if 5xx > 5% within 5m of rollout, auto-disable flag and notify
Nina (oncall): DevOps: please link postmortem and assign postmortem owner.
Liam (platform): I'll own the postmortem and include improved rollout gates + canary traffic slope limits.
Priya (product): Notifying top-10 affected customers via account reps; contacting support to surface any escalations.
Flagbot: No further toggles detected.
alerts-bot: Alert cleared for /v1/prompt-router/adaptive-splitter at 12:34 UTC.
Nina (oncall): Marking incident as mitigated in PD and Incident page. Will reopen if we get regressions. Thanks for rapid response. :raised_hands:
